explanation: This fires only at the GO step, and only early in the episode (trials 2 to 5) when the agent chooses a2 right after an unrewarded trial: about 10 at trial 2, about 7 to 10 at trials 4 to 5, and lower (around 3) if the trial before was also unrewarded. At every other step it is 0, including all D1 and D2 steps, trial 0, choices of a1 (at most 1), rewarded previous trials, and anything after about trial 8 (at most 1 or 2 later on).
